digest.component_or_area: review-bot container Bedrock authorization via instance role
propositions: The review-bot container lacks IAM authorization to invoke Bedrock; an inline policy granting bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream must be attached to the existing rebar-gerrit-instance-role without modifying iam.tf

IMDSv2 is reachable from inside the review-bot container on the host (default assumption verified via AC1 token PUT probe), making this an IAM-only story unless the token request fails, which would trigger the hop-limit contingency
The Converse API authorizes against bedrock:InvokeModel (not bedrock:Converse), proven by real instance calls; granting the wrong action name yields AccessDeniedException at runtime
Cross-region inference profiles require both foundation-model and inference-profile ARNs with region wildcards; pinning region or profile prefix silently denies valid model IDs at runtime
A policy simulator cannot distinguish which IAM action a service actually checks; only a real call from the scoped role (never from a wildcard-holding identity) proves authorization correctness
Verification must include three layers: simulator validation, a real Converse call from the instance, and a negative control against non-Claude models to prove scope is enforced
